items.title: 56422_Leonard Phillips oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] That's interesting. How about Billy Taylor -- pianist Billy Taylor. The guy who came from North Carolina. Do you remember him? [INTERVIEWEE] That played here, in town?

ctx.x: because he came to Chicago before King Oliver. So he wrote a lot of tunes. He wrote "The Hesitation Blues" and he wrote "King Porter Stomp" and he wrote "Milenberg Joys" and he wrote "The Pearls" and he wrote "Kansas City Stomp".
That's interesting. How about Billy Taylor -- pianist Billy Taylor. The guy who came from North Carolina. Do you remember him?
